data.title: Cullinan: CLN-978 Data Could Drive Upside; Buy Rating Reiterated, $36 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
JonesTrading analyst Boris Peaker has maintained their bullish stance on CGEM stock, giving a Buy rating today.

Boris Peaker’s rating is based on the potential of Cullinan’s CLN-978, a CD19xCD3 T-cell engager, to generate meaningful responses in difficult-to-treat autoimmune diseases. He sees the forthcoming update in lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and Sjögren’s disease as an important opportunity to establish activity across several indications. The key upside would come from repeated-dose results showing remission signals that strengthen over time.

Peaker also expects the release to clarify whether cytokine-release syndrome and other safety risks remain manageable, while helping define Phase II dose levels and treatment schedules. A credible development plan, including prioritized indications, competitive differentiation, and a plausible regulatory route, could increase confidence in the program’s commercial potential. Against recent share-price pressure, these catalysts support the Buy rating, while the price target remains unchanged at $36.

data.title: INOVIO: EMA Filing for VOCERYQ Supports European Expansion; Analyst Maintains $5 Price Target
data.description:
Ram Selvaraju, an analyst from H.C. Wainwright, reiterated the Buy rating on Inovio Pharmaceuticals. The associated price target remains the same with $5.00.

Ram Selvaraju’s rating is based on several factors, led by INOVIO’s submission of a conditional marketing application to the EMA for VOCERYQ in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP). The filing could extend the therapy’s reach into Europe, where patients currently lack an approved nonsurgical option addressing the disease’s underlying cause. He views the application as a constructive step toward broader commercialization following the product’s accelerated U.S. approval, while maintaining the $5 price target.

His optimism is also supported by clinical and long-term efficacy data, evidence of stronger immune responses, and manufacturing information assembled for regulators. Prior orphan-drug status, EMA advanced-therapy certification, pre-submission consultation, and the CE-marked delivery device further strengthen the regulatory and launch foundation. With U.S. availability expected in early 2027 and supply sufficient for the initial rollout, these catalysts outweigh the remaining review and confirmatory-study risks.

In another report released on November 11, Piper Sandler also reiterated a Buy rating on the stock with a $6.00 price target.
